pattern.typical_deadline_window: Early-to-mid September (CHI 2026: abstract 4 Sep / paper 11 Sep 2025; CHI 2027: single paper deadline 10 Sep 2026, no separate abstract deadline), 23:59 AoE.
pattern.typical_notification_month: Reviews released early November; revise-and-resubmit due early December; final decisions mid-December (2027) or mid-January (2026).
pattern.typical_conference_month: April-May (2025 Yokohama 26 Apr-1 May; 2026 Barcelona 13-17 Apr; 2027 Pittsburgh 10-14 May).

pattern.review_process: Double-anonymous; one AC meta-review plus (normally) three external reviews, followed by a ~4-week revise-and-resubmit phase for papers above a threshold, then a final decision. CHI 2027 adds a desk-reject and 'assisted desk reject' (ADR) triage so only ~50-60% of submissions go to full external review (ADR notifications ~26 Oct 2026); submitting authors must collectively complete four reviews.
pattern.resubmission_rules: Concurrent submissions of the same or directly-related work elsewhere must be declared in the 'concurrent submissions' field with an anonymized copy; failure to do so is a desk reject (chi2027.acm.org/authors/papers). ACM prohibits simultaneous submission of substantially the same work to another archival venue. arXiv preprint policy not restated on the 2027 papers page (not verified here).
